package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"sync/atomic"
	"time"

	"github.com/alibaba/higress/plugins/wasm-go/pkg/mcp"
	"github.com/alibaba/higress/plugins/wasm-go/pkg/mcp/server"
	"github.com/alibaba/higress/plugins/wasm-go/pkg/mcp/utils"
)

var runtimeCreates, runtimeCalls atomic.Uint64

// A new VM must never look like an unchanged zero counter after recycling.
var runtimeGeneration = fmt.Sprintf("%d", time.Now().UnixNano())

type runtimeRawSummaryTool struct{ raw []byte }

func (t *runtimeRawSummaryTool) Create(raw []byte) server.Tool {
	runtimeCreates.Add(1)
	return &runtimeRawSummaryTool{raw: bytes.Clone(raw)}
}
func (t *runtimeRawSummaryTool) Call(ctx server.HttpContext, _ server.Server) error {
	runtimeCalls.Add(1)
	utils.OnMCPResponseSuccess(ctx, map[string]any{
		"rawLength": len(t.raw), "rawSha256": fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(t.raw)),
	}, "runtime:raw-summary")
	return nil
}
func (t *runtimeRawSummaryTool) Description() string {
	return "raw Create contract and bounded result fixture"
}
func (t *runtimeRawSummaryTool) InputSchema() map[string]any {
	return map[string]any{"type": "object", "required": []string{"schemaOnly"},
		"custom": runtimeDescriptorMarshaler{}, "raw": json.RawMessage(`{"number":900719925474099312345}`)}
}
func (t *runtimeRawSummaryTool) OutputSchema() map[string]any {
	return map[string]any{"type": "object", "properties": map[string]any{"rawLength": map[string]any{"type": "integer"}}}
}

type runtimeDescriptorMarshaler struct{}

func (runtimeDescriptorMarshaler) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) {
	return []byte(`{"value":"serialized","number":900719925474099312345}`), nil
}

type runtimeCountersTool struct{}

func (t *runtimeCountersTool) Create([]byte) server.Tool { return t }
func (t *runtimeCountersTool) Call(ctx server.HttpContext, _ server.Server) error {
	utils.OnMCPResponseSuccess(ctx, map[string]any{"generation": runtimeGeneration, "creates": runtimeCreates.Load(), "calls": runtimeCalls.Load()}, "runtime:counters")
	return nil
}
func (t *runtimeCountersTool) Description() string {
	return "business execution counter without incrementing it"
}
func (t *runtimeCountersTool) InputSchema() map[string]any { return map[string]any{"type": "object"} }

type runtimeNumericSchemaTool struct{}

func (t *runtimeNumericSchemaTool) Create(_ []byte) server.Tool { return t }
func (t *runtimeNumericSchemaTool) Call(_ server.HttpContext, _ server.Server) error {
	return nil
}
func (t *runtimeNumericSchemaTool) Description() string { return "numeric comparison bound fixture" }
func (t *runtimeNumericSchemaTool) InputSchema() map[string]any {
	return map[string]any{
		"type": "object",
		"properties": map[string]any{
			"value": map[string]any{
				"type": "number",
				"enum": []any{json.Number("1e5000")},
			},
		},
	}
}

func init() {
	fixtureServer := mcp.NewMCPServer()
	fixtureServer.AddMCPTool("numeric_comparison", &runtimeNumericSchemaTool{})
	fixtureServer.AddMCPTool("raw_summary", &runtimeRawSummaryTool{})
	fixtureServer.AddMCPTool(strings.Repeat("n", 5000), &runtimeRawSummaryTool{})
	fixtureServer.AddMCPTool(strings.Repeat("界", 3000), &runtimeRawSummaryTool{})
	fixtureServer.AddMCPTool("runtime_counters", &runtimeCountersTool{})
	mcp.LoadMCPServer(mcp.AddMCPServer("runtime-schema-fixtures", fixtureServer))
}
